notes.title: New co-op Horror Game BloodLight is coming!
notes.content:
Hello there!
This month we plan to launch early access to our new co-op horror game BloodLight. The game is very realistic, you will play as a night watchman who must complete all his tasks in order to leave the spooky and atmospheric warehouse. You will go alone or with your friends against a really aggressive demon that changes its forms and tries to kill you!

[u]More info:[/u] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950190/BloodLight/

[b]Official Teaser Trailer:[/b] [previewyoutube=WeK3_jYv_T0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]When will the game be released?[/b]
[list]
[*] We are planning to release BloodLight Early Access in the middle of this month. 
[/list]
[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
[list]
[*] Early access will cost $15 and the initial discount will be 35%. Once the full game is released, the game will be priced at $5.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes, we plan to make a demo available a few days after the early access release.
[/list]
[b]When will the full version be released?[/b]
[list]
[*] We plan for the Early Access to last for a month, and in the meantime the game will be fully completed and then the full version will be released
[/list]
Thank you for your support! 
- Team Galactic Games

notes.title: We're offering you free early access to our Revenguard game!
notes.content:
Hello!
We would like to offer you free early access to our latest game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2418680/Revenguard/]Revenguard[/url].

Revenguard game description:
Revenguard is set in the ancient past in the territory of the kingdom of Revenguard. Your mission is to rescue your best friend who has been kidnapped by very hostile slimes who want to conquer the kingdom of Revenguard and take over the world. Rescuing your little dog will not be easy. Your best friend is being held in a castle that has already been taken over by the slimeballs. This is also where the slime lord is hiding. But getting there can be challenging. Along the way, you'll have to solve various tasks, jump from tree to tree, climb mountains or crawl through creepy caves, and most importantly, avoid the slimes who will try to kill you as soon as they see you. Good luck, the Revenguard Kingdom needs you!

Interested in our product?
"Revenguard" will be available on Steam at the end of August. So if you are interested in free early access to "Revenguard", contact us at this email address: galacticgames.business@gmail.com and we will provide you with a key to our game "Revenguard" in exchange for streaming, making a video or any kind of promotion of our game.

Have fun playing and have a galactic day!

- Galactic Games Team

notes.title: Winter Sale 2021
notes.content:
I developed Mainly at Rest to prove to people that it can be an eternal challenge rather than finishing Getting over it or ALTF4. I wish you good luck in advance.

- Mainly at rest is a climbing game similar to Getting over it but this time you will need your legs and endurance.

- Climb a huge snow mountain full of pitfalls and traps to overcome all obstacles and end the suffering.

- But the game isn't as hard as it seems to follow your path and you'll make it

- With the help of your leg, you'll soon be able to run, jump and fly.

- The average time to play a tester is 2 hours. I thank them in advance for their help in developing the game.
(I didn't finish the game)

Show me what you can do and conquer my challenge!
(Good luck)
